Alias.name: genv
Alias.script: if GENVENOM and GENVENOM.command then GENVENOM.command(matches[2] or "") else cecho("<red>[GEnvenom] Startup failed; reinstall g_envenom.xml.<reset>\n") end

Script.name: GEnvenom
Script.script:
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- GEnvenom -- ID-safe Envenom tracking and maintenance for Aardwolf/Mudlet. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
GENVENOM = GENVENOM or {} local genv = GENVENOM
genv.version = "1.0.4" genv.config = genv.config or {} genv.runtime = genv.runtime or {} genv.triggers = genv.triggers or {} genv.handlers = genv.handlers or {} genv.timers = genv.timers or {} genv.recovery = genv.recovery or {}
local defaults = { autoOwn = false, autoBorrowed = false, debug = false, warningSeconds = 30, maxAttempts = 3, identifyTimeout = 7, actionTimeout = 6, } for key, value in pairs(defaults) do if genv.config[key] == nil then genv.config[key] = value end end
local function trim(value) return tostring(value or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") end
local function normalized(value) local text = tostring(value or "") text = text:gsub("@.", "") text = text:gsub("<[^>]+>", "") text = text:gsub("%s+", " ") return trim(text):lower() end
local AARD_CECHO_COLORS = { b = "ansi_blue", B = "ansi_light_blue", c = "ansi_cyan", C = "ansi_light_cyan", r = "ansi_red", R = "ansi_light_red", m = "ansi_magenta", M = "ansi_light_magenta", g = "ansi_green", G = "ansi_light_green", y = "ansi_yellow", Y = "ansi_light_yellow", w = "ansi_white", W = "white", D = "ansi_light_black", }
local function expandAardColors(value) local escapedAt = "\1GENV_ESCAPED_AT\1" local text = tostring(value or ""):gsub("@@", escapedAt) text = text:gsub("@([A-Za-z])", function(code) local colorName = AARD_CECHO_COLORS[code] return colorName and ("<" .. colorName .. ">") or ("@" .. code) end) return text:gsub(escapedAt, "@") end
local function numericId(value) local id = tostring(value or ""):match("^%s*(%d+)%s*$") if id == "0" then return nil end return id end
local function truthy(value) return value == true or value == 1 or tostring(value):lower() == "true" end
local function now() return os.time() end
function genv.print(message, color) color = color or "cyan" if type(cecho) == "function" then cecho(string.format("<%s>[GEnvenom]<reset> <%s>%s\n", color, color, expandAardColors(message))) else print("[GEnvenom] " .. tostring(message or "")) end end
function genv.debug(message) if genv.config.debug then genv.print(message, "dim_grey") end end
local function sendCommand(command) if type(send) ~= "function" then genv.print("Mudlet send() is unavailable; command not sent: " .. tostring(command), "red") return false end genv.debug("send: " .. tostring(command)) send(command, false) return true end
local function killTimerField(name) local id = genv.timers[name] if id and type(killTimer) == "function" then pcall(killTimer, id) end genv.timers[name] = nil end
local function after(seconds, name, callback) killTimerField(name) if type(tempTimer) ~= "function" then callback() return nil end genv.timers[name] = tempTimer(math.max(0, tonumber(seconds) or 0), function() genv.timers[name] = nil callback() end) return genv.timers[name] end
local function settingsDir() local home = type(getMudletHomeDir) == "function" and getMudletHomeDir() or "." local dir = home .. "/GEnvenom" if type(mkdir) == "function" then pcall(mkdir, dir) end if type(lfs) == "table" and type(lfs.mkdir) == "function" then pcall(lfs.mkdir, dir) end return dir end
local function settingsPath() return settingsDir() .. "/settings.lua" end
function genv.saveSettings() local file = io.open(settingsPath(), "w") if not file then genv.print("Could not save settings.", "orange_red") return false end file:write("return {\n") file:write(" autoOwn = ", tostring(genv.config.autoOwn == true), ",\n") file:write(" autoBorrowed = ", tostring(genv.config.autoBorrowed == true), ",\n") file:write(" debug = ", tostring(genv.config.debug == true), ",\n") if numericId(genv.recovery.id) and (genv.recovery.slot == "wielded" or genv.recovery.slot == "second") then file:write(" recovery = { id = ", string.format("%q", tostring(genv.recovery.id)), ", slot = ", string.format("%q", tostring(genv.recovery.slot)), " },\n") end file:write("}\n") file:close() return true end
function genv.loadSettings() local chunk = loadfile(settingsPath()) if not chunk then return false end local ok, saved = pcall(chunk) if not ok or type(saved) ~= "table" then return false end if saved.autoOwn ~= nil then genv.config.autoOwn = saved.autoOwn == true end if saved.autoBorrowed ~= nil then genv.config.autoBorrowed = saved.autoBorrowed == true end if saved.debug ~= nil then genv.config.debug = saved.debug == true end if type(saved.recovery) == "table" and numericId(saved.recovery.id) and (saved.recovery.slot == "wielded" or saved.recovery.slot == "second") then genv.recovery = { id = tostring(saved.recovery.id), slot = saved.recovery.slot } else genv.recovery = {} end return true end
local function gmcpChar() if type(gmcp) ~= "table" then return {}, {}, {} end local root = gmcp.char or gmcp.Char or {} return root, root.base or root.Base or {}, root.status or root.Status or {} end
function genv.characterState() local _, base, status = gmcpChar() local level = tonumber(status.level or base.level) local tier = tonumber(base.tier or status.tier) return { name = trim(base.name or status.name), race = trim(base.race or status.race), subclass = trim(base.subclass or status.subclass), level = level, tier = tier, combatState = tonumber(status.state or status.pos or status.position), } end
function genv.isEligible() local state = genv.characterState() local race = normalized(state.race) local subclass = normalized(state.subclass) if race == "naga" or subclass == "venomist" then return true end if race == "" and subclass == "" then return false, "race/subclass is not available from GMCP" end return false, "character is neither Naga nor Venomist" end
function genv.tierLevel() local state = genv.characterState() if state.level == nil or state.tier == nil then return nil, state.level, state.tier end local level = math.max(0, math.floor(state.level)) local tier = math.max(0, math.floor(state.tier)) return level + (tier * 10), level, tier end
function genv.inCombat() return genv.characterState().combatState == 8 end
local function dinvReady() if type(DINV) ~= "table" or type(DINV.api) ~= "table" then return false end if type(DINV.api.getItem) ~= "function" or type(DINV.api.getEquipped) ~= "function" then return false end if type(DINV.api.isReady) == "function" then local ok, ready = pcall(DINV.api.isReady) if not ok or ready ~= true then return false end end return true end
local ITEM_FIELDS = { "id", "name", "colorName", "colorname", "type", "level", "location", "worn", "isWorn", }
local function dinvItem(id) if not dinvReady() then return nil, false end local ok, result = pcall(DINV.api.getItem, tostring(id), { detail = "full", source = "live", fields = ITEM_FIELDS, }) if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" then return nil, false end if result.ok then return result.item, true end if tostring(result.code or ""):upper() == "NOT_FOUND" then return nil, true end return nil, false end
local function itemName(item, id) local name = trim(item and (item.colorName or item.colorname or item.name) or "") if name ~= "" then return name end local current = id and dinvItem(id) or nil name = trim(current and (current.colorName or current.colorname or current.name) or "") if name ~= "" then return name end return "weapon " .. tostring(id or "?") end
local function itemIsWorn(item) return type(item) == "table" and truthy(item.isWorn) end
local function equippedAt(slot) if type(DINV.api.getEquipped) ~= "function" then return nil, false end local ok, result = pcall(DINV.api.getEquipped, slot, { detail = "full", source = "live", fields = ITEM_FIELDS, }) if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" or not result.ok then return nil, false end for _, item in ipairs(result.items or {}) do if numericId(item.id) then return item, true end end if type(result.item) == "table" and numericId(result.item.id) then return result.item, true end return nil, true end
local function cancelWeaponTimers(id) killTimerField("warning:" .. tostring(id)) killTimerField("expiry:" .. tostring(id)) end
local function markWeaponDirty(weapon, status) if not weapon then return end cancelWeaponTimers(weapon.id) weapon.dirty = true weapon.status = status or "unknown" weapon.expiresAt = nil weapon.warned = false end
function genv.syncEquipped() if not dinvReady() then return false, "DINV is not ready" end
local slotItems = {} local assigned = {}
-- Once a weapon ID is tracked, its DINV isWorn field is authoritative. -- Do not rediscover it by parsing a Worn label or by trusting an empty slot query. for _, slot in ipairs({ "wielded", "second" }) do local trackedId = genv.runtime.bySlot[slot] local tracked = trackedId and genv.runtime.weapons[trackedId] or nil if tracked then local current, known = dinvItem(trackedId) if current and itemIsWorn(current) then slotItems[slot] = current assigned[trackedId] = true elseif not known and tracked.item then -- BUSY/NOT_READY is not evidence that the weapon was removed. slotItems[slot] = tracked.item assigned[trackedId] = true end end end
-- Slot queries are used only to discover a new ID for an untracked slot. -- Existing IDs above are never erased by an empty getEquipped() response. for _, slot in ipairs({ "wielded", "second" }) do if not slotItems[slot] then local item, ok = equippedAt(slot) if not ok then return false, "DINV could not read the " .. slot .. " slot" end local id = item and numericId(item.id) or nil if id and itemIsWorn(item) and not assigned[id] then slotItems[slot] = item assigned[id] = true end end end
-- On a fresh session there are no IDs to query yet. If DINV discovers one -- weapon slot directly but omits the other, get all worn items and assign -- the sole remaining worn weapon to the sole missing weapon slot. This uses -- only public API IDs, type, and isWorn; the human-readable Worn label is ignored. local missingSlots = {} for _, slot in ipairs({ "wielded", "second" }) do if not slotItems[slot] then table.insert(missingSlots, slot) end end if #missingSlots == 1 and type(DINV.api.getEquipment) == "function" then local ok, result = pcall(DINV.api.getEquipment, { detail = "full", source = "live", fields = ITEM_FIELDS, }) if ok and type(result) == "table" and result.ok then local candidates = {} for _, item in ipairs(result.items or {}) do local id = numericId(item.id) if id and not assigned[id] and itemIsWorn(item) and normalized(item.type) == "weapon" then table.insert(candidates, item) end end if #candidates == 1 then local slot = missingSlots[1] local id = numericId(candidates[1].id) slotItems[slot] = candidates[1] assigned[id] = true end end end
local found = {} local bySlot = {} for _, slot in ipairs({ "wielded", "second" }) do local item = slotItems[slot] if item then local id = numericId(item.id) if id then found[id] = true bySlot[slot] = id local weapon = genv.runtime.weapons[id] if not weapon then weapon = { id = id, slot = slot, status = "unknown", dirty = true, warned = false } genv.runtime.weapons[id] = weapon elseif weapon.slot ~= slot then weapon.slot = slot markWeaponDirty(weapon, "unknown") end weapon.item = item -- display cache only; never persisted end end end
for id, weapon in pairs(genv.runtime.weapons) do if not found[id] then cancelWeaponTimers(id) genv.runtime.weapons[id] = nil end end genv.runtime.bySlot = bySlot return true end
local function remainingSeconds(weapon) if not weapon or weapon.dirty or not weapon.expiresAt then return nil end return math.max(0, weapon.expiresAt - now()) end
local function formatDuration(seconds) seconds = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(seconds) or 0)) return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(seconds / 60), seconds % 60) end
local function queuedOwn(id) local active = genv.runtime.active if active and active.kind == "own" and active.id == id then return true end for _, job in ipairs(genv.runtime.queue) do if job.kind == "own" and job.id == id then return true end end return false end
function genv.enqueue(job) if type(job) ~= "table" then return false end if job.kind == "own" and queuedOwn(job.id) then return false end table.insert(genv.runtime.queue, job) genv.runNext() return true end
local function trackedWeaponName(weapon) local item = weapon and weapon.item or nil return normalized(item and (item.name or item.colorName or item.colorname) or "") end
local function expiredMessageCandidates(displayName) local wanted = normalized(displayName) local named = {} local due = {} for _, weapon in pairs(genv.runtime.weapons or {}) do local remaining = remainingSeconds(weapon) local nearExpiry = remaining == nil or remaining <= 90 if wanted ~= "" and trackedWeaponName(weapon) == wanted then table.insert(named, weapon) end if nearExpiry then table.insert(due, weapon) end end
if #named == 1 then return named end if #named > 1 then local nearNamed = {} for _, weapon in ipairs(named) do local remaining = remainingSeconds(weapon) if remaining == nil or remaining <= 90 then table.insert(nearNamed, weapon) end end return #nearNamed > 0 and nearNamed or named end return due end
function genv.onExpiredMessage(displayName) local eligible = genv.isEligible() if not eligible then return end
local candidates = expiredMessageCandidates(displayName) if #candidates == 0 then -- Recover IDs on a fresh/previously uncertain session, then match again. genv.syncEquipped() candidates = expiredMessageCandidates(displayName) end table.sort(candidates, function(left, right) local leftRank = left.slot == "wielded" and 1 or 2 local rightRank = right.slot == "wielded" and 1 or 2 if leftRank ~= rightRank then return leftRank < rightRank end return tostring(left.id) < tostring(right.id) end)
for _, weapon in ipairs(candidates) do markWeaponDirty(weapon, "expired by Aardwolf") if genv.config.autoOwn then genv.enqueue({ kind = "own", id = weapon.id, slot = weapon.slot, source = "expiry message" }) end end end
local function setWeaponDuration(weapon, seconds) if not weapon then return end seconds = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(seconds) or 0)) cancelWeaponTimers(weapon.id) weapon.dirty = false weapon.status = "active" weapon.expiresAt = now() + seconds weapon.warned = false
local warningAt = seconds - genv.config.warningSeconds after(math.max(0, warningAt), "warning:" .. weapon.id, function() local current = genv.runtime.weapons[weapon.id] if not current or current.dirty or current.warned then return end current.warned = true genv.print(itemName(current.item, current.id) .. " <orange_red>(" .. current.id .. ") has about 30 seconds of Envenom remaining.", "orange_red") end)
after(seconds + 1, "expiry:" .. weapon.id, function() local current = genv.runtime.weapons[weapon.id] if not current then return end markWeaponDirty(current, "due for verification") if genv.config.autoOwn then genv.enqueue({ kind = "own", id = current.id, slot = current.slot, source = "expiry" }) else genv.print(itemName(current.item, current.id) .. " <orange_red>(" .. current.id .. ") is due for an Envenom check.", "orange_red") end end) end
local function killOperationTimers() killTimerField("operation") killTimerField("identifyTimeout") killTimerField("identifyQuiet") killTimerField("poll") end
function genv.finishActive(delay) killOperationTimers() genv.runtime.identify = nil genv.runtime.active = nil after(delay or 0.1, "nextJob", genv.runNext) end
local function returnBorrowed(job, tellMessage) if tellMessage and tellMessage ~= "" then sendCommand("tell " .. job.sender .. " " .. tellMessage) end sendCommand("give " .. job.id .. " " .. job.sender) genv.print("Returned weapon " .. job.id .. " to " .. job.sender .. ".", "green") genv.finishActive(0.2) end
local function tooPowerfulBorrowed(job) local cap = genv.tierLevel() local level = tonumber(job.level) local levelText = level and tostring(math.floor(level)) or "an unknown level" local capText = cap and tostring(cap) or "my current tier level" returnBorrowed(job, "Sorry, that weapon is level " .. levelText .. "; I can only envenom up to level " .. capText .. ".") end
local function pollItem(job, predicate, onSuccess, onFailure, attempts) attempts = tonumber(attempts) or 0 local item = dinvItem(job.id) if item and predicate(item) then onSuccess(item) return end if attempts >= 20 then onFailure(item) return end after(0.25, "poll", function() pollItem(job, predicate, onSuccess, onFailure, attempts + 1) end) end
local function restoreOwn(job, callback, preserveStatus) local weapon = genv.runtime.weapons[job.id] local slot = job.slot or (weapon and weapon.slot) or "wielded" job.stage = "restoring" sendCommand("wear " .. job.id .. " " .. slot) pollItem(job, function(item) return itemIsWorn(item) end, function(item) job.removed = false if tostring(genv.recovery.id or "") == tostring(job.id) then genv.recovery = {} genv.saveSettings() end if weapon then weapon.item = item or weapon.item end if not preserveStatus and weapon then markWeaponDirty(weapon, "unknown") end callback(true) end, function() if weapon then markWeaponDirty(weapon, "restore unconfirmed") end genv.print("Could not confirm that " .. job.id .. " was restored to " .. slot .. ".", "red") callback(false) end) end
local function failOwned(job, message) local weapon = genv.runtime.weapons[job.id] if weapon then markWeaponDirty(weapon, "error") end if message then genv.print(message, "red") end if job.removed or job.removedRequested then restoreOwn(job, function() genv.finishActive() end, false) else genv.finishActive() end end
local function borrowedFailure(job, reason) returnBorrowed(job, "Sorry, I could not envenom that weapon after " .. tostring(genv.config.maxAttempts) .. " attempts, so I am returning it.") genv.debug("Borrowed envenom failed: " .. tostring(reason)) end
function genv.startEnvenom(job) local eligible, reason = genv.isEligible() if not eligible then if job.kind == "own" then failOwned(job, "Envenom stopped: " .. tostring(reason) .. ".") else returnBorrowed(job, "Sorry, I cannot use Envenom right now, so I am returning your weapon.") end return end if genv.inCombat() then if job.kind == "own" and (job.removed or job.removedRequested) then restoreOwn(job, function() local weapon = genv.runtime.weapons[job.id] if weapon then markWeaponDirty(weapon, "deferred for combat") end genv.finishActive() end, false) else job.stage = "waitingCombatEnv" genv.print("Envenom for " .. job.id .. " deferred until combat ends.", "orange_red") end return end
job.attempts = (tonumber(job.attempts) or 0) + 1 job.stage = "envenoming" if not sendCommand("envenom " .. job.id) then genv.onEnvenomFailure("send() unavailable") return end after(genv.config.actionTimeout, "operation", function() if genv.runtime.active == job and job.stage == "envenoming" then genv.onEnvenomFailure("no result received") end end) end
function genv.onEnvenomFailure(reason) local job = genv.runtime.active if not job or job.stage ~= "envenoming" then return end killTimerField("operation") if (tonumber(job.attempts) or 0) < genv.config.maxAttempts then genv.print("Envenom attempt " .. tostring(job.attempts) .. " failed for " .. job.id .. "; trying again.", "orange_red") job.stage = "retryWait" after(1.0, "operation", function() if genv.runtime.active == job then genv.startEnvenom(job) end end) return end if job.kind == "own" then failOwned(job, "Envenom failed three times for weapon " .. job.id .. ".") else borrowedFailure(job, reason) end end
function genv.onEnvenomSuccess() local job = genv.runtime.active if not job or job.stage ~= "envenoming" then return end killTimerField("operation") if job.kind == "borrowed" then returnBorrowed(job) return end genv.startIdentify(job, false, "post") end
function genv.onTooPowerful() local job = genv.runtime.active if not job or job.stage ~= "envenoming" then return end killTimerField("operation") if job.kind == "borrowed" then tooPowerfulBorrowed(job) else failOwned(job, "Aardwolf rejected owned weapon " .. job.id .. " as too powerful to envenom.") end end
function genv.onAlreadyEnvenomed() local job = genv.runtime.active if not job or job.stage ~= "envenoming" then return end killTimerField("operation") if job.kind == "borrowed" then returnBorrowed(job, "That weapon is already envenomed, so I am returning it.") else genv.startIdentify(job, false, "post") end end
local function parseIdentifyLine(capture, text) text = tostring(text or "") local isIdentifyOutput = text:match("^%s*|") ~= nil or text:match("^%s*%+%-+%+%s*$") ~= nil local id = text:match("|%s*Id%s*:%s*(%d+)") if id then capture.data.id = id capture.sawTarget = id == tostring(capture.job.id) end if not capture.sawTarget then return isIdentifyOutput end
local itemType = text:match("|%s*Type%s*:%s*([%a ]-)%s+Level%s*:") if itemType then capture.data.type = trim(itemType) end local level = text:match("Level%s*:%s*([%d,]+)") if level then capture.data.level = tonumber((level:gsub(",", ""))) end local minutes, seconds = text:match("|%s*Envenom%s*:.-%((%d+):(%d+)%)") if minutes and seconds then capture.data.duration = (tonumber(minutes) * 60) + tonumber(seconds) end return isIdentifyOutput end
function genv.onIdentifyLine(text) local capture = genv.runtime.identify if not capture then return false end local isIdentifyOutput = parseIdentifyLine(capture, text) if isIdentifyOutput and capture.sawTarget and not capture.tagged then after(0.7, "identifyQuiet", function() if genv.runtime.identify == capture then genv.finishIdentifyCapture(capture) end end) end return isIdentifyOutput end
function genv.onIdentifyStart() local capture = genv.runtime.identify if capture then capture.tagged = true capture.gagActive = true if type(deleteLine) == "function" then deleteLine() end end end
function genv.onIdentifyEnd() local capture = genv.runtime.identify if not capture then return end if type(deleteLine) == "function" then deleteLine() end capture.gagActive = false if capture.sawTarget then genv.finishIdentifyCapture(capture) else -- Another script may have identified an item while our request was queued. -- Ignore that complete block and continue waiting for our exact ID. capture.tagged = false capture.data = {} end end
function genv.startIdentify(job, worn, purpose) killTimerField("identifyTimeout") killTimerField("identifyQuiet") job.stage = "identifying" job.identifyPurpose = purpose local capture = { job = job, purpose = purpose, tagged = false, sawTarget = false, data = {}, } genv.runtime.identify = capture local command = "identify " .. job.id .. (worn and " worn" or "") if not sendCommand(command) then genv.failIdentifyCapture(capture, "identify command was not sent") return end after(genv.config.identifyTimeout, "identifyTimeout", function() if genv.runtime.identify == capture then genv.failIdentifyCapture(capture, "identify output timed out") end end) end
function genv.failIdentifyCapture(capture, reason) if genv.runtime.identify ~= capture then return end killTimerField("identifyTimeout") killTimerField("identifyQuiet") genv.runtime.identify = nil local job = capture.job if job.kind == "own" then failOwned(job, "Could not refresh Envenom status for " .. job.id .. ": " .. tostring(reason) .. ".") else returnBorrowed(job, "Sorry, I could not identify that weapon safely, so I am returning it.") end end
local function identifyTypeAndLevel(job, data) local item = dinvItem(job.id) local itemType = trim(data.type or (item and item.type) or "") local level = tonumber(data.level or (item and item.level)) return itemType, level, item end
local function startOwnRemove(job) if genv.inCombat() then local weapon = genv.runtime.weapons[job.id] if weapon then weapon.status = "deferred for combat" end genv.runtime.active = nil table.insert(genv.runtime.queue, 1, job) genv.print("Weapon " .. job.id .. " needs Envenom; refresh deferred until combat ends.", "orange_red") return end
job.stage = "removing" job.removedRequested = true -- This is a recovery journal, not timer persistence. It lets a later load -- restore an exact weapon if the connection dies during our transaction. genv.recovery = { id = tostring(job.id), slot = tostring(job.slot) } genv.saveSettings() if not sendCommand("remove " .. job.id) then failOwned(job, "Could not send remove for weapon " .. job.id .. ".") return end pollItem(job, function(item) return not itemIsWorn(item) and normalized(item.location) == "inventory" end, function(item) job.removed = true job.removedRequested = false local weapon = genv.runtime.weapons[job.id] if weapon then weapon.item = item or weapon.item; weapon.status = "refreshing" end genv.startEnvenom(job) end, function() failOwned(job, "Could not confirm removal of weapon " .. job.id .. "; attempting to restore it.") end) end
function genv.finishIdentifyCapture(capture) if genv.runtime.identify ~= capture then return end killTimerField("identifyTimeout") killTimerField("identifyQuiet") local job = capture.job local data = capture.data if not capture.sawTarget or tostring(data.id or "") ~= tostring(job.id) then genv.failIdentifyCapture(capture, "identify output did not contain the expected ID") return end genv.runtime.identify = nil
local itemType, level, item = identifyTypeAndLevel(job, data) job.level = level job.item = item if normalized(itemType) ~= "weapon" then if job.kind == "borrowed" then genv.print("Received item " .. job.id .. " from " .. job.sender .. " is not a weapon; borrowed mode left it untouched.", "cyan") genv.finishActive() else failOwned(job, "Equipped ID " .. job.id .. " did not identify as a weapon.") end return end
if job.kind == "borrowed" then local cap = genv.tierLevel() if not cap or not level then returnBorrowed(job, "Sorry, I could not verify that weapon's level safely, so I am returning it.") elseif level > cap then tooPowerfulBorrowed(job) elseif data.duration then returnBorrowed(job, "That weapon is already envenomed, so I am returning it.") else genv.startEnvenom(job) end return end
local weapon = genv.runtime.weapons[job.id] if not weapon then genv.finishActive() return end weapon.item = item or weapon.item if data.duration then setWeaponDuration(weapon, data.duration) if capture.purpose == "post" and (job.removed or job.removedRequested) then restoreOwn(job, function() genv.finishActive() end, true) else genv.finishActive() end elseif capture.purpose == "post" then markWeaponDirty(weapon, "post-envenom identify was inconclusive") restoreOwn(job, function() genv.finishActive() end, false) else weapon.dirty = false weapon.status = "missing" weapon.expiresAt = nil weapon.warned = false startOwnRemove(job) end end
local function startBorrowed(job) -- Identify every borrowed candidate. This authoritatively confirms both type and level before envenoming. genv.startIdentify(job, false, "borrowed") end
local function startOwn(job) local weapon = genv.runtime.weapons[job.id] if not weapon or weapon.slot ~= job.slot then genv.finishActive() return end local item = dinvItem(job.id) if not item or not itemIsWorn(item) then genv.syncEquipped() weapon = genv.runtime.weapons[job.id] if not weapon or genv.runtime.bySlot[job.slot] ~= job.id then if weapon then markWeaponDirty(weapon, "no longer equipped") end genv.finishActive() return end item = weapon.item or item end weapon.item = item weapon.status = "checking" genv.startIdentify(job, true, "pre") end
function genv.runNext() if genv.runtime.active then return end if genv.runtime.connected == false then return end if genv.runtime.recovering or genv.runtime.recoveryPending then return end if #genv.runtime.queue == 0 then return end local eligible, reason = genv.isEligible() if not eligible then genv.debug("queue paused: " .. tostring(reason)) return end if genv.inCombat() then if not genv.runtime.combatNotice then genv.runtime.combatNotice = true genv.print("Envenom queue paused until combat ends.", "orange_red") end return end genv.runtime.combatNotice = false local job = table.remove(genv.runtime.queue, 1) genv.runtime.active = job if job.kind == "borrowed" then startBorrowed(job) else startOwn(job) end end
function genv.requestCheck(manual) local eligible, reason = genv.isEligible() if not eligible then genv.print("Check not started: " .. tostring(reason) .. ".", "orange_red") return false end if genv.runtime.recovering or genv.runtime.recoveryPending then genv.recoverInterrupted(function(ok) if ok then genv.requestCheck(manual) elseif manual then genv.print("The interrupted equipment restore is still pending.", "orange_red") end end) return false end if genv.runtime.active and genv.runtime.active.kind == "own" and (genv.runtime.active.removed or genv.runtime.active.removedRequested) then if manual then genv.print("An owned-weapon refresh is already in progress.", "orange_red") end return false end local ok, err = genv.syncEquipped() if not ok then genv.print("Cannot check wielded weapons: " .. tostring(err) .. ".", "red") return false end local count = 0 for _, slot in ipairs({ "wielded", "second" }) do local id = genv.runtime.bySlot[slot] local weapon = id and genv.runtime.weapons[id] or nil local remaining = remainingSeconds(weapon) local needsAutomaticCheck = weapon == nil or weapon.dirty == true or weapon.status ~= "active" or remaining == nil or remaining <= 0 if id and (manual or needsAutomaticCheck) and genv.enqueue({ kind = "own", id = id, slot = slot, source = manual and "manual" or "auto" }) then count = count + 1 end end if manual then genv.print(count > 0 and ("Queued " .. count .. local function scheduleAutoCheck(delay) if not genv.config.autoOwn then return end after(delay or 0.6, "autoCheck", function() if genv.config.autoOwn then genv.requestCheck(false) end end) end
local function pruneInbound() local cutoff = now() - 5 local ids, senders = {}, {} for _, entry in ipairs(genv.runtime.inboundIds) do if entry.at >= cutoff then table.insert(ids, entry) end end for _, entry in ipairs(genv.runtime.inboundSenders) do if entry.at >= cutoff then table.insert(senders, entry) end end genv.runtime.inboundIds = ids genv.runtime.inboundSenders = senders end
local function pairInbound() pruneInbound() while #genv.runtime.inboundIds > 0 and #genv.runtime.inboundSenders > 0 do local idEntry = table.remove(genv.runtime.inboundIds, 1) local senderEntry = table.remove(genv.runtime.inboundSenders, 1) genv.enqueue({ kind = "borrowed", id = idEntry.id, sender = senderEntry.sender, attempts = 0, source = "received", }) end end
function genv.onInvmon(payload) payload = tostring(payload or "") if not genv.config.autoBorrowed then return end local eligible = genv.isEligible() if not eligible then return end local id = payload:match("^4,(%d+),%-1,%-1$") if not id then return end table.insert(genv.runtime.inboundIds, { id = id, at = now() }) pairInbound() end
function genv.onReceived(sender) if not genv.config.autoBorrowed then return end local eligible = genv.isEligible() if not eligible then return end sender = tostring(sender or ""):match("^(%w+)$") if not sender then return end table.insert(genv.runtime.inboundSenders, { sender = sender, at = now() }) pairInbound() end
function genv.markAllDirty(status) for _, weapon in pairs(genv.runtime.weapons or {}) do markWeaponDirty(weapon, status or "unknown") end end
function genv.onDisconnect() genv.markAllDirty("dirty after disconnect") killOperationTimers() killTimerField("autoCheck") killTimerField("nextJob") killTimerField("connectResume") local pendingBorrowed = {} local active = genv.runtime.active if active and active.kind == "borrowed" then active.stage = nil table.insert(pendingBorrowed, active) end for _, job in ipairs(genv.runtime.queue) do if job.kind == "borrowed" then job.stage = nil; table.insert(pendingBorrowed, job) end end genv.runtime.active = nil genv.runtime.identify = nil genv.runtime.queue = pendingBorrowed genv.runtime.connected = false end
function genv.onConnect() genv.runtime.connected = true genv.markAllDirty("dirty after reconnect") after(1.0, "connectResume", function() genv.recoverInterrupted(genv.resumeAfterRecovery) end) end
function genv.onGMCPStatus() local charState = genv.characterState() if charState.combatState == 1 or charState.combatState == 2 then if not genv.runtime.loginPending then genv.markAllDirty("dirty after relog") end genv.runtime.loginPending = true elseif genv.runtime.loginPending then genv.runtime.loginPending = false genv.markAllDirty("dirty after relog") scheduleAutoCheck(1.0) end local wasCombat = genv.runtime.inCombat == true local inCombat = genv.inCombat() genv.runtime.inCombat = inCombat if inCombat and not wasCombat then local job = genv.runtime.active if job and job.kind == "own" and (job.removed or job.removedRequested) then killOperationTimers() genv.runtime.identify = nil restoreOwn(job, function() local weapon = genv.runtime.weapons[job.id] if weapon then markWeaponDirty(weapon, "deferred for combat") end genv.finishActive() end, false) end elseif not inCombat and wasCombat then genv.runtime.combatNotice = false if numericId(genv.recovery.id) then genv.recoverInterrupted(function(ok) if ok then genv.runNext() end end) return end local job = genv.runtime.active if job and job.stage == "waitingCombatEnv" then genv.startEnvenom(job) else genv.runNext() end end end
function genv.onGMCPBase() local characterName = normalized(genv.characterState().name) local characterChanged = false if characterName ~= "" and genv.runtime.characterName ~= "" and characterName ~= genv.runtime.characterName then characterChanged = true genv.markAllDirty("dirty after character change") end if characterName ~= "" then genv.runtime.characterName = characterName end if genv.runtime.recoveryPending then genv.recoverInterrupted(function(ok) if ok and characterChanged and genv.config.autoOwn then scheduleAutoCheck(0.8) end end) return end if characterChanged and genv.config.autoOwn then scheduleAutoCheck(0.8) end genv.runNext() end
function genv.resumeAfterRecovery(ok) if ok == false and numericId(genv.recovery.id) then genv.runtime.recoveryRetries = (tonumber(genv.runtime.recoveryRetries) or 0) + 1 if genv.runtime.recoveryRetries <= 8 then after(1.0, "recoveryRetry", function() genv.recoverInterrupted(genv.resumeAfterRecovery) end) else genv.print("Interrupted equipment restore remains pending; use 'genv check' after DINV is ready.", "orange_red") end return end genv.runtime.recoveryRetries = 0 if genv.config.autoOwn then genv.requestCheck(false) end genv.runNext() end
function genv.recoverInterrupted(callback) callback = callback or function() end local id = numericId(genv.recovery.id) local slot = genv.recovery.slot if not id or (slot ~= "wielded" and slot ~= "second") then genv.recovery = {} callback(true) return end if genv.runtime.connected == false or genv.inCombat() then genv.runtime.recoveryPending = true callback(false) return end if genv.runtime.recovering then callback(false) return end if not dinvReady() then genv.runtime.recoveryPending = true genv.print("Interrupted restore for " .. id .. " is waiting for DINV.", "orange_red") callback(false) return end
local item = dinvItem(id) if item and itemIsWorn(item) then genv.recovery = {} genv.runtime.recoveryPending = false genv.saveSettings() callback(true) return end if not item or normalized(item.location) ~= "inventory" then genv.runtime.recoveryPending = true genv.print("Interrupted restore for " .. id .. ".", "orange_red") sendCommand("wear " .. id .. " " .. slot) pollItem(recoveryJob, function(current) return itemIsWorn(current) end, function() genv.runtime.recovering = false genv.recovery = {} genv.saveSettings() genv.markAllDirty("dirty after interrupted restore") callback(true) end, function() genv.runtime.recovering = false genv.runtime.recoveryPending = true genv.print("Could not confirm interrupted restore for weapon " .. id .. ".", "red") callback(false) end) end
local function clearQueued(kind) local kept = {} for _, job in ipairs(genv.runtime.queue) do if job.kind ~= kind then table.insert(kept, job) end end genv.runtime.queue = kept end
local function setMode(mode, value) value = normalized(value) if value ~= "on" and value ~= "off" then genv.print("Usage: genv " .. (mode == "own" and "owned" or mode) .. " on|off", "orange_red") return end local enabled = value == "on" if mode == "own" then genv.config.autoOwn = enabled if enabled then scheduleAutoCheck(0.1) else clearQueued("own") end else genv.config.autoBorrowed = enabled if not enabled then genv.runtime.inboundIds = {} genv.runtime.inboundSenders = {} clearQueued("borrowed") end end genv.saveSettings() genv.print("Automatic " .. mode .. "-weapon Envenom is " .. (enabled and "ON." or "OFF."), enabled and "green" or "orange_red") end

" status", "cyan") genv.print(" Character: " .. (state.name ~= "" and state.name or "unknown") .. " | race " .. (state.race ~= "" and state.race or "unknown") .. " | subclass " .. (state.subclass ~= "" and state.subclass or "unknown"), "white") genv.print(" Eligible: " .. (eligible and "yes" or ("no (" .. tostring(reason) .. ")")) .. " | combat: " .. (genv.inCombat() and "yes" or "no") .. " | tier-level cap: " .. tostring(cap or "unknown"), eligible and "white" or "orange_red") genv.print(" Auto own: " .. for _, slot in ipairs({ "wielded", "second" }) do local id = genv.runtime.bySlot[slot] local weapon = id and genv.runtime.weapons[id] or nil if weapon then local remaining = remainingSeconds(weapon) local timerText = remaining and formatDuration(remaining) or (weapon.dirty and "dirty" or "unknown") genv.print(string.format(" %-7s %s [%s] | %s | %s", slot, itemName(weapon.item, id), id, tostring(weapon.status or "unknown"), timerText), "white") else genv.print(string.format(" %-7s (empty)", slot), "dim_grey") end end end
function genv.help() genv.print("Commands", "cyan") genv.print(" genv status show eligibility, modes, queue, and wielded timers", "white") genv.print(" genv check identify and maintain wielded/second weapons now", "white") genv.print(" genv owned on|off toggle unattended owned-weapon maintenance", "white") genv.print(" genv borrowed on|off toggle envenom-and-return for every received weapon", "white") genv.print(" genv debug on|off toggle diagnostic output", "white") genv.print(" genv help show this help", "white") genv.print("Timers are session-only and become dirty after disconnect, relog, or reload.", "dim_grey") end
function genv.command(input) local line = trim(input) local command, rest = line:match("^(%S+)%s*(.-)$") rest = rest or "" command = normalized(command or "status") if command == "" or command == "status" then genv.status() elseif command == "help" then genv.help() elseif command == "check" then genv.requestCheck(true) elseif command == "auto" then local mode, value = tostring(rest):match("^(%S+)%s+(%S+)%s*$") mode = normalized(mode) if mode ~= "own" and mode ~= "borrowed" then genv.print("Usage: genv auto own|borrowed on|off", "orange_red") else setMode(mode, value) end elseif command == "own" or command == "owned" or command == "borrowed" then setMode(command == "owned" and "own" or command, rest) elseif command == "debug" then local value = normalized(rest) if value ~= "on" and value ~= "off" then genv.print("Usage: genv debug on|off", "orange_red") return end genv.config.debug = value == "on" genv.saveSettings() genv.print("Debug is " .. (genv.config.debug and "ON." or "OFF."), "cyan") else genv.print("Unknown command. Use 'genv help'.", "orange_red") end end
function genv.shutdownRuntime() local timerNames = {} for name in pairs(genv.timers or {}) do table.insert(timerNames, name) end for _, name in ipairs(timerNames) do killTimerField(name) end for _, id in pairs(genv.triggers or {}) do if id and type(killTrigger) == "function" then pcall(killTrigger, id) end end for _, id in pairs(genv.handlers or {}) do if id and type(killAnonymousEventHandler) == "function" then pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, id) end end genv.triggers, genv.handlers, genv.timers = {}, {}, {} end
function genv.installRuntime() genv.shutdownRuntime() genv.loadSettings() genv.runtime = { weapons = {}, bySlot = {}, queue = {}, active = nil, identify = nil, inboundIds = {}, inboundSenders = {}, inCombat = genv.inCombat(), connected = true, characterName = normalized(genv.characterState().name), loginPending = false, recovering = false, recoveryPending = numericId(genv.recovery.id) ~= nil, recoveryRetries = 0, }
genv.triggers.allLines = tempRegexTrigger("^(.*)$", function() local capture = genv.runtime.identify if capture and matches then local text = matches[2] or matches[1] local isTag = text == "{identify}" or text == "{/identify}" if not capture.gagActive and text:match("^%s*%+%-+%+%s*$") then capture.gagActive = true end local isIdentifyOutput = genv.onIdentifyLine(text) if capture.gagActive and capture.sawTarget and not isIdentifyOutput and not isTag then -- Untagged fallback: the first line after the table belongs to the user/game, -- so finish our capture without deleting that line. capture.gagActive = false genv.finishIdentifyCapture(capture) return end if capture.gagActive and not isTag and type(deleteLine) == "function" then deleteLine() end end end) genv.triggers.identifyStart = tempRegexTrigger("^\\{identify\\}$", genv.onIdentifyStart) genv.triggers.identifyEnd = tempRegexTrigger("^\\{/identify\\}$", genv.onIdentifyEnd) genv.triggers.invmon = tempRegexTrigger("^\\{invmon\\}(.*)$", function() if matches then genv.onInvmon(matches[2]) end end) genv.triggers.received = tempRegexTrigger("^You receive .* from (\\w+)\\.$", function() if matches then genv.onReceived(matches[2]) end end) genv.triggers.success = tempRegexTrigger("^You coat .* with deadly poison\\.$", genv.onEnvenomSuccess) genv.triggers.expired = tempRegexTrigger("^Your (.+) is no longer envenomed\\.$", function() if matches then genv.onExpiredMessage(matches[2]) end end) genv.triggers.tooPowerful = tempRegexTrigger("^.* is too powerful for you to envenom\\.$", genv.onTooPowerful) genv.triggers.already = tempRegexTrigger("(?i)^.*already.*(?:envenom|poison).*$", genv.onAlreadyEnvenomed) genv.triggers.failure = tempRegexTrigger( "(?i)^(?:You failed\\.?|You fail(?:ed)? to .*|You cannot envenom .*|You can't envenom .*|You do not know how to envenom.*|You don't know how to envenom.*)$", function() genv.onEnvenomFailure(matches and matches[1] or "Aardwolf rejected the attempt") end)

sendCommand("tags invmon on") sendCommand("tags identify on") genv.print("Loaded v" .. genv.version .. ". Use 'genv check', 'genv status', or 'genv help'.", "green") after(1.0, "startup", function() genv.recoverInterrupted(genv.resumeAfterRecovery) end) end
